preconditions.description: The number of BubbleCores N must be between 3 and 15000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= U < N and 0 <= V < N and U != V for U, V in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct BubbleCores within the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum sum of all BubbleCores' potentials.
